name: spinney
description: A minimalistic agent harness — sidebar chat with file read/write and command execution, powered by the official DeepSeek API.

commands.title: Spinney: Delete Branch at Checked-out Turn

spinney.apiKey.markdownDescription: DeepSeek API key. Get one at https://platform.deepseek.com. Alternatively set the `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` environment variable.

spinney.model.markdownDescription: DeepSeek model to use. `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, 1M-token context) accepts image input — attach or paste images in the chat. Additional models, and per-model context-window / image overrides, come from `spinney.modelTable`.

vision.description: Whether the model accepts image input (attach/paste, read_image).

max_tokens.description: The model's context window in tokens — the budget the usage indicator divides by, not the API's max_tokens output cap.

propertyNames.patternErrorMessage: A model id cannot contain spaces or a colon.

spinney.commandTimeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) a command may run before being killed. Default 600 (10 minutes); used as the default for exec_command when the tool call does not pass its own timeout.

spinney.maxTurns.description: Maximum tool-call rounds per user message to prevent runaway loops.

spinney.contextWindow.description: Context window (in tokens) for the context-usage indicator, used for models that are neither vendored nor listed in spinney.modelTable. A modelTable row wins over this. Leave 0 to use the catalog's window.

spinney.thinkingEffort.description: How much effort the model should spend reasoning before answering. 'low'/'medium'/'high' send a reasoning_effort hint; 'none' omits the parameter and uses the API default.

spinney.foldToolCalls.description: Collapse tool-call cards by default in the chat tree; expand them by clicking the header.

spinney.foldThinking.description: Collapse the reasoning/thinking block by default in the chat tree; expand it by clicking its header.

spinney.maxConcurrentSubagents.description: How many level-1 sub-agents the main agent may run concurrently (a slot pool; extra tasks queue).

spinney.maxLevel2Subagents.description: How many sub-sub-agents each sub-agent may start. Depth is hard-capped at 2 (no sub-sub-sub-agent).

spinney.saveSubAgentTranscripts.description: Write each finished sub-agent's full conversation to disk as JSONL (one API message per line, meta + tool-call stats on line 1) and hand its path back to the caller.

spinney.saveSessionTranscripts.description: Write each finished main-agent turn to disk as JSONL (same format as sub-agent transcripts) so search_transcripts can recall earlier conversations. Session history otherwise lives only in the extension's stored state.

spinney.subAgentTranscriptDir.description: Folder for transcript dumps (main-agent turns + sub-agent runs), relative to the harness root (the workspace folder, or the harness scratch folder when no folder is open); a per-session subfolder is created inside. Leave empty to use the extension's global storage.

spinney.autoSessionTitles.description: Name sessions automatically: after the first turn, and again once the conversation has grown (at most every 2 minutes). Titles are generated by the model, falling back to the first message when the request fails. Renaming a session manually locks its title. Sessions created before this feature are named once on activation.

spinney.maxInlineToolOutput.description: Maximum size (bytes) of a search_files / list_dir / search_transcripts result returned inline. Larger results are written to a temp file and only its path plus a short preview are returned. Set 0 to always inline.

spinney.httpApi.enabled.description: Expose a local HTTP control plane on 127.0.0.1 (bearer-token gated) so an external controller such as tools/hyper-vscode can read state, wait for the agent to go idle, navigate to a node, and continue from it. Off by default; /continue lets the caller make the agent run an instruction, so treat it as a local-trust boundary.

spinney.httpApi.port.description: Port for the HTTP control plane. 0 picks a free port; the chosen port and token are written to <globalStorage>/http/<instanceId>.json for the supervisor to discover.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run check:models && npm run check:webview && npm run check:signals
